narr: Thunderstorms brought locally heavy rain to southeastern Pennsylvania during the morning and early afternoon of August 28. Rainfall totals were as high as 2.5 to 4.5 inches.
ev: Multiple vehicles were stuck in flood waters around the intersection of PA Route 61 and PA Route 12, requiring several water rescues.
Widespread roadway flooding occurred in Spring Township. Fritztown Road, Chapel Hill Road, Geisinger Road and Wheatfield Road were closed due to flooding.
Mount Laurel Road in Temple was closed due to flooding.
Park Avenue in Sinking Spring was closed at Penn Avenue due to flooding.
A water rescue from a vehicle took place on Schultz Road in Worcester Township.
PA Route 291 was closed in Tinicum Township due to flooding.
Several streets were under water in North Philadelphia around Temple University.
